sources.snippet: Stanford AI Graduate Program: CS229-Final Project - Multitask and Multilingual Classifier Motivation: One of the key challenges in building a multilingual classifier is ensuring consistent accuracy and fairness across languages. Variations in both quantity and quality of training data for different languages often lead to performance disparities.
